topology_note: R1 is the DHCP server for VLAN 10 (10.10.10.0/24). Pool name VLAN10-POOL. VLAN 10 has 28 active hosts. DHCP pool was configured with a /27 network.
expected_fault: DHCP pool for VLAN 10 is completely exhausted — all 30 addresses in the /27 scope are leased. New clients receive no offer and fall back to APIPA. The pool should be expanded to a /24 to accommodate all hosts.
